# Preference Compass

> An experiment in user-owned relationship portability across AI sessions and platforms, by Deshimaru Sakaguchi.

Questionnaires provide initial observations, not personality scores or established trust. Complete initial responses are required, including unknown or declined. Dialogue-updated sheets have no fixed item count. Transfer the complete schema, handling protocol and current relationship data; task progress is excluded.

## Author and public use

- [Deshimaru Sakaguchi](https://deshimarusakaguchi.com/)
- [AI use policy](https://preferencecompass.info/AI-USE.md): Indexing, retrieval and AI training on public materials are permitted; private answers are not public.
- [Use and attribution](https://preferencecompass.info/en/terms.md)

## Canonical specifications

- [Handling protocol](https://preferencecompass.info/spec/handling-protocol-1.1.0.md)
- [Machine protocol](https://preferencecompass.info/spec/handling-protocol-1.1.0.json)
- [JSON Schema](https://preferencecompass.info/spec/relationship-portability-1.1.1.schema.json)
